column1: # The fixture ratchet. Two-directional: tests/run-policy-tests.sh fails when a
# fixture exists on disk without a line here AND when a line here has no
# fixture on disk. Deleting an inconvenient sensitivity fixture is therefore a
# CI failure, not a quiet loss of coverage.
